span.label: weakly modeled - THE PAPER COINS THIS ABOUT ITSELF AND SAYS WHY. cWB is introduced as an unmodeled search, but the analysis reported here restricts it to signals that chirp in the time-frequency plane, so it is no longer model-free. The authors change the word rather than keep the stronger one
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: marginal - NEITHER ESTABLISHED NOR EXCLUDED, and the paper holds that line to the end. A marginal trigger passed the false-alarm threshold but was given less than a 50% probability of astrophysical origin by both matched-filter searches. It is not a non-detection and not a weak detection: it is a candidate the collaboration declines to resolve, and it says so in the conclusions as well as the results
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: false-alarm rate - AN EMPIRICAL RATE MEASURED AGAINST TIME-SHIFTED DATA, NOT A PROBABILITY THAT THE EVENT IS NOISE. Where a candidate outranks every background trigger the search can only report a BOUND, and the bound depends on how much background time was available - which is why some FARs here are larger than the ones previously published for the same events
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: independent, of the three searches - INDEPENDENCE OF METHOD, NOT OF EVIDENCE. The conclusions say `three independent analyses` flatly; what is independent is the pipeline, the ranking statistic and the noise model, while the strain data are the same in all three. The body is more careful than the conclusion, which is worth knowing before the agreement between them is read as three confirmations
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: GW versus marginal - A THRESHOLD CONVENTION, NOT A PROPERTY OF THE UNIVERSE. The boundary is a false-alarm rate ceiling of 1 per 30 days followed by a 50% astrophysical probability, both chosen by the collaboration. An event just under the line and one just over it differ by the convention, and the paper presents the choice as a choice
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: detection, in the phrase `no new gravitational-wave events were discovered` - THE O1 REANALYSIS FOUND NOTHING NEW BUT DID CHANGE AN OLD ANSWER. The same data through better pipelines moved LVT151012 across the threshold and it is now GW151012. So the null result is about new events only; the catalog's contents still changed
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
